cards.originalTitle: TriAttention: Unified Sparse Mixed-Precision Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference
cards.whyItMatters: 长上下文LLM推理的主要成本来自注意力计算和KV缓存重复读取。该工作把稀疏跳过与混合精度结合，并提供与上下文长度无关的策略表示，为在受限算力下维持长上下文质量提供了一种可校准的工程路径。
cards.summary: 事实：论文将QK瓦片分配为跳过、4位或8位计算，用两条对角距离边界表示每个头的计算区域，并通过离线校准和模型级分配器在共享算力预算下最小化校准误差。事实：实验报告端到端生成相对Torch注意力最高7.88倍、相对BF16基线2.65倍加速，同时在通用与长上下文任务上质量与原模型相当。作者观点：结果表明紧凑的保留与精度策略能把局部敏感性转化为注意力计算和重复KV缓存访问的节省。
cards.description: 提出按查询-键瓦片将注意力计算分为跳过、4位与8位三类，并用离线校准在整体算力预算下为每个头选择边界，从而在长上下文推理中同时利用稀疏性和量化。其新意在于把“可跳过”与“可低精度”区分开，用与上下文长度无关的紧凑策略存储降低注意力与KV缓存读取成本。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: the paper assigns QK tiles to skip, 4-bit, or 8-bit computation, encodes each head's computation regions with two diagonal-distance boundaries, and uses offline calibration plus a model-wide allocator to minimize calibration error under a shared compute budget. Fact: experiments report end-to-end generation speedups of up to 7.88x over Torch attention and 2.65x over the BF16 baseline while maintaining quality comparable to the original models on general-purpose and long-context tasks. Authors' view: the results show that a compact retention-and-precision policy can translate local sensitivities into savings in attention computation and repeated KV-cache access.
cards.titleEn: TriAttention: Unified Sparse Mixed-Precision Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者在特定模型和基准上的实验，摘要未列出具体模型规模、数据集、校准成本与精度损失细节；7.88倍与2.65倍加速为报告的最高值，实际收益依赖硬件、内核实现与工作负载；质量“相当”的结论需结合完整评测表判断，且离线校准策略对新分布数据的泛化性未在摘要中说明。
cards.descriptionEn: It assigns query-key tiles to skipping, 4-bit, or 8-bit computation and uses offline calibration to choose per-head boundaries under a shared compute budget, exploiting sparsity and quantization together for long-context inference. Its novelty lies in separating removal-tolerant from quantization-tolerant interactions and in a compact policy representation independent of context length that reduces attention and KV-cache read costs.
cards.title: TriAttention：统一稀疏与混合精度长上下文注意力
keyPointsEn: QK tiles are classified into skip, 4-bit, and 8-bit computation, with 4-bit retaining quantization-tolerant interactions at lower cost.
Two diagonal-distance boundaries encode each head's computation regions, keeping policy storage independent of context length.
Prefill generates precision-grouped traversals executed by a fused kernel, and quantized keys and values are reused in a compressed KV cache for decoding.
keyPoints: 按QK瓦片区分跳过、4位和8位计算，4位用于保留可容忍量化的交互以降低开销。
用两条对角距离边界编码每个头的计算区域，使策略存储不随上下文长度增长。
预填充阶段生成按精度分组的遍历并由融合内核执行，量化后的键值复用于解码阶段的压缩KV缓存。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the authors' experiments on specific models and benchmarks; the abstract does not detail model sizes, datasets, calibration cost, or precision-loss specifics. The 7.88x and 2.65x speedups are reported maxima and depend on hardware, kernel implementation, and workload; the claim of comparable quality requires the full evaluation tables, and generalization of the offline calibrated policy to new data distributions is not addressed in the abstract.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The dominant cost of long-context LLM inference comes from attention computation and repeated KV-cache reads. By combining sparse skipping with mixed precision and a context-length-independent policy representation, the work offers a calibratable engineering path toward maintaining long-context quality under constrained compute.

cards.originalTitle: Modality-Aware Expert Pruning for MoE-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
cards.whyItMatters: 若结论成立，该方法可在不重新训练的情况下大幅压缩 MoE 多模态大模型的专家权重，降低显存门槛，使原本超出单卡容量的模型可在 40 GB GPU 上部署。
cards.summary: MoE 多模态大模型中专家参数占模型大小 90% 以上，现有剪枝方法对所有 token 统一聚合专家重要性，忽略了同一专家在视觉与语言处理中的角色差异。作者提出免训练框架 MAEP，用 Delta-H 输出变化度量和低注意力视觉 token 作为视觉侧剪枝信号，并以文本侧重要性作为保留信号，跨层全局排序专家。实验在三个 MoE 多模态大模型上多数多模态基准优于模态无关基线，文本任务保持竞争力，BF16 专家权重减少约 27 GB（约占总内存 47%）。
cards.description: 新在提出免训练的 MAEP 框架，将专家重要性按模态分解；有用于在不重训的前提下显著降低 MoE 多模态大模型的专家权重内存占用。
cards.summaryEn: Expert parameters account for over 90% of model size in MoE multimodal LLMs, yet existing pruning methods aggregate expert importance uniformly across tokens, ignoring that the same expert may serve different roles in vision versus language processing. The authors propose MAEP, a training-free framework that uses Delta-H output change and low-attention vision tokens as a vision-side pruning signal, with text-side importance as a preservation signal, ranking experts globally across layers. Experiments on three MoE multimodal LLMs show MAEP outperforms modality-agnostic baselines on most multimodal benchmarks while remaining competitive on text-only tasks, reducing BF16 expert weights by about 27 GB (about 47% of total memory).
cards.titleEn: Modality-Aware Expert Pruning Compresses MoE Multimodal LLMs by Distinguishing Visual and Language Roles
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自三个 MoE 多模态大模型上的基准实验，未涉及更广泛模型家族、真实部署延迟或下游任务鲁棒性；低注意力视觉 token 信号的数据集稳定性需在更多数据集验证；剪枝后文本任务仅保持竞争力，未显示提升；免训练特性不保证在其他模态组合或训练分布外同样有效。
cards.descriptionEn: Novelty lies in the training-free MAEP framework that decomposes expert importance by modality; useful for substantially reducing expert weight memory of MoE multimodal LLMs without retraining.
cards.title: 模态感知专家剪枝：按视觉与语言角色区分压缩 MoE 多模态大模型
keyPointsEn: MAEP decomposes expert importance by modality, using vision-side importance for pruning and text-side importance for preservation, with global ranking across layers.
It introduces Delta-H to measure MoE output change when an expert is removed and uses low-attention vision tokens as a dataset-stable vision pruning signal.

On three MoE multimodal LLMs, it outperforms modality-agnostic baselines on most multimodal benchmarks and remains competitive on text tasks; BF16 expert weights drop by about 27 GB (about 47% of total memory), fitting an approximately 58 GB model into a single 40 GB GPU.
keyPoints: MAEP 将专家重要性按模态分解，视觉侧重要性用于剪枝、文本侧重要性用于保留，并跨层全局排序。
引入 Delta-H 度量专家移除后 MoE 输出变化，并用低注意力视觉 token 作为数据集稳定的视觉剪枝信号。
在三个 MoE 多模态大模型上，多数多模态基准优于模态无关基线，文本任务有竞争力；BF16 专家权重减少约 27 GB（约 47% 总内存），使约 58 GB 模型可放入单张 40 GB GPU。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from benchmark experiments on three MoE multimodal LLMs; broader model families, real deployment latency, and downstream robustness are not covered. The dataset stability of the low-attention vision token signal needs validation on more datasets. Text tasks remain competitive but show no improvement after pruning. The training-free property does not guarantee effectiveness under other modality combinations or out-of-distribution settings.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the findings hold, this method can substantially compress expert weights of MoE multimodal LLMs without retraining, lowering the memory barrier and enabling models that exceed single-GPU capacity to be deployed on a 40 GB GPU.

cards.originalTitle: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
cards.whyItMatters: 哈密顿量预测是AI辅助电子结构计算的关键环节。将学习空间与哈密顿量的直积表示对齐，有望减少冗余变换、提升内存与硬件执行效率，并更直接地建模轨道耦合；MP-HAM-110K的大规模多元素数据也为该方向提供了新的基准资源。
cards.summary: 现有等变哈密顿量预测模型多在直和空间传播特征，与目标哈密顿量的直积表示不匹配，导致算符块碎片化、轨道耦合操作不直接且计算效率受限。作者提出DP-Learner，直接在直积空间对哈密顿量型算符块进行等变消息传递，无需显式Clebsch-Gordan分解或逆重构，并实例化为Transformer架构；同时发布覆盖68种元素、超过11万材料结构的MP-HAM-110K数据集。作者报告在MP-HAM-110K和Materials-HAM-SOC上，DP-Learner的预测精度与推理效率均显著优于现有最优方法，但上述性能结论来自作者实验，尚待独立复现与更广泛材料体系验证。
cards.description: 该工作指出目标哈密顿量天然是局部轨道与自旋基上的直积表示，而多数等变模型在不可约球张量的直和空间中传播特征，存在表示错配。作者提出DP-Learner，直接在直积空间的哈密顿量型算符块上进行消息传递，并构建了超过11万材料结构的大规模数据集MP-HAM-110K。新方法在哈密顿量预测精度和推理效率上均显著优于此前最优方法，为电子结构预测提供了更贴合物理表示的学习框架。
cards.summaryEn: Existing equivariant Hamiltonian prediction models typically propagate features in direct-sum spaces, mismatching the direct-product representation of target Hamiltonians and causing fragmented operator blocks, indirect orbital-coupling manipulation, and computational inefficiency. The authors propose DP-Learner, which performs equivariant message passing directly on Hamiltonian-like operator blocks in the direct-product space without explicit Clebsch-Gordan decomposition or inverse reconstruction, instantiated as a Transformer architecture; they also release MP-HAM-110K, covering 68 elements and over 110,000 material structures. The authors report that DP-Learner substantially improves prediction accuracy and inference efficiency over the state of the art on MP-HAM-110K and Materials-HAM-SOC, but these performance claims come from the authors' experiments and await independent reproduction and validation on broader material systems.
cards.titleEn: DP-Learner: Equivariant Learning in Direct-Product Space Improves Hamiltonian Prediction
cards.limitations: 性能提升结论基于作者在MP-HAM-110K和Materials-HAM-SOC上的实验，尚未经独立复现或更广泛材料体系验证；数据集覆盖68种元素但未说明其结构与化学空间代表性；方法对SO(3)、SU(2)和空间反演等变性的保持依赖特定架构实现，实际部署中的数值稳定性与泛化边界仍需进一步检验。
cards.descriptionEn: The work identifies a representation mismatch: target Hamiltonians are naturally operator blocks in a direct-product representation over local orbital and spin bases, whereas most equivariant models propagate features in direct-sum spaces of irreducible spherical tensors. The authors propose DP-Learner, which performs message passing directly on Hamiltonian-like operator blocks in the direct-product space, and construct MP-HAM-110K, a large-scale dataset of over 110,000 mater
cards.title: DP-Learner：直积空间等变学习提升哈密顿量预测
keyPointsEn: DP-Learner performs equivariant message passing directly on Hamiltonian-like operator blocks in the direct-product space, avoiding block fragmentation and representation mismatch caused by direct-sum representations.

It introduces Lie-generator-based directional embedding and invariantly weighted left-right products and contractions that preserve equivariance to SO(3), SU(2), and spatial inversion without explicit Clebsch-Gordan decomposition or inverse reconstruction.
It constructs MP-HAM-110K, a dataset of over 110,000 material structures covering 68 elements, with both Hamiltonian and wavefunction data.
keyPoints: DP-Learner直接在直积空间的哈密顿量型算符块上做等变消息传递，避免直和表示造成的块碎片化与表示错配。
提出基于李生成元的定向嵌入及不变加权左右乘积与缩并，在保持SO(3)、SU(2)和空间反演等变性的同时无需显式Clebsch-Gordan分解或逆重构。
构建MP-HAM-110K数据集，包含超过11万材料结构、覆盖68种元素，并同时提供哈密顿量与波函数数据。
cards.limitationsEn: The performance gains are based on the authors' experiments on MP-HAM-110K and Materials-HAM-SOC and have not yet been independently reproduced or validated on broader material systems; the dataset covers 68 elements but its structural and chemical-space representativeness is not specified; preserving equivariance to SO(3), SU(2), and spatial inversion depends on the specific architecture, and numerical stability and generalization boundaries in practical deployment require further testing.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Hamiltonian prediction is a key step in AI-assisted electronic-structure computation. Aligning the learning space with the direct-product representation of Hamiltonians may reduce redundant transformations, improve memory and hardware execution efficiency, and more directly model orbital couplings; the large multi-element MP-HAM-110K dataset also provides a new benchmark resource for this direction.

cards.originalTitle: CoMPAS3D: A Dataset and Benchmark for Interactive Motion
cards.whyItMatters: 交互式人形机器人需实时理解同伴动作含义，而非仅复制轨迹。该工作把舞蹈中共享动作词汇和社区评判标准转化为可计算评测，为检验生成回应动作是否合适提供可操作框架；若指标与专家判断稳定相关，可弥补纯运动学指标的语义盲区。
cards.summary: 作者受围棋、国际象棋计算化评估启发，将萨尔萨舞设为双人、有舞步词汇和社区认可评判标准的交互评估域。CoMPAS3D 收录 18 位初、中、专业舞者约 3 小时即兴共舞，并有逾 2800 段专家标注片段，覆盖舞步类型、执行错误与风格元素。基准任务为舞步分类、熟练度估计和跟随者生成，作者用微调视觉语言模型和 Duolando、InterGen 做初步验证。
cards.description: 该工作提出 CoMPAS3D 动作捕捉数据集与 Salsa 具身交互评估域，用舞步词汇、客观指标与竞赛式主观维度评判生成的双人回应动作；新意在于把“动作是否合乎共享动作语义”纳入评测，而不再只依赖 FID、节拍对齐等运动学指标。
cards.summaryEn: Inspired by computational evaluation of games such as Go and Chess, the authors propose Salsa as a dyadic interaction domain with a move vocabulary and community-validated judging criteria. CoMPAS3D contains about 3 hours of improvised partner salsa by 18 dancers at beginner, intermediate, and professional levels, with over 2,800 expert-annotated segments covering move types, execution errors, and stylistic elements. The benchmark tasks are move classification, proficiency estimation, and follower generation; the authors preliminarily validate them with fine-tuned vision-language models and with Duolando and InterGen.
cards.titleEn: CoMPAS3D: Evaluating Interactive Motion Generation with Partner Salsa Dance
cards.limitations: 证据来自单一舞种（萨尔萨）和有限舞者规模（18 人），能否推广到其他交互动作与人群尚不清楚。专家标注与六项主观维度仍依赖人工判断；微调视觉语言模型与客观指标同专家判断的相关性只是初步结果，不能视为通用测量效度已确立。对 Duolando、InterGen 的差距结论仅限所测模型与设定。
cards.descriptionEn: The work introduces CoMPAS3D, a motion-capture dataset and the Salsa embodied-interaction evaluation domain, judging generated dyadic reactive motions via a move vocabulary, objective metrics, and competition-style subjective dimensions; its novelty lies in testing whether motions fit a shared movement semantics rather than relying only on kinematic metrics such as FID and beat alignment.
cards.title: CoMPAS3D：用萨尔萨舞评估交互式动作生成
keyPointsEn: About 3 hours of dyadic improvised salsa motion capture from 18 dancers spanning beginner, intermediate, and professional levels.
More than 2,800 expert-annotated segments covering move types, execution errors, and stylistic elements, enabling fine-grained semantic evaluation.
Three benchmark tasks (move classification, proficiency estimation, follower generation) plus two objective metrics: move legibility and proficiency appropriateness.
keyPoints: 数据集含约 3 小时双人即兴萨尔萨动作捕捉，18 位舞者覆盖初、中、专业三档水平。
标注超过 2800 段，含舞步类型、执行错误和风格元素，为细粒度语义评估提供条件。
设定舞步分类、熟练度估计、跟随者生成三个基准任务，并引入可读性与熟练度匹配两项客观指标。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from a single dance style (salsa) and a limited set of 18 dancers, so generalization to other interactive motions and populations is unclear. Expert annotation and the six subjective dimensions still depend on human judgment; the correlation of fine-tuned vision-language models and objective metrics with expert judgment is preliminary and does not establish general measurement validity. The gap reported for Duolando and InterGen is limited to the tested models and settings.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Socially interactive humanoids must understand what a partner's movements mean in real time, not just copy trajectories. This work turns shared movement vocabulary and community judging criteria in dance into computable evaluation, offering an operational framework for testing whether generated reactive motions are appropriate; if the metrics correlate stably with expert judgment, they can address the semantic blind spots of purely kinematic measures.

cards.originalTitle: EntropyCache: Decoded Token Entropy Guided KV Caching for Diffusion Language Models
cards.whyItMatters: 为扩散语言模型提供了一种无需训练的近似KV缓存策略，显著降低推理延迟，且决策开销恒定，有利于实际部署。
cards.summary: 扩散语言模型因双向注意力导致KV缓存无法无损复用，每步去噪需全量前向。作者提出EntropyCache，以解码令牌最大熵为信号，在缓存漂移大时重算最近k个令牌，实现恒定成本决策。实验显示在多项基准上获得15.2–26.4倍加速，准确率有竞争力，决策开销占比极低。
cards.description: EntropyCache是一种无需训练的KV缓存方法，利用新解码令牌分布的最大熵作为恒定成本信号，决定何时重算缓存。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上实现15.2至26.4倍加速，准确率保持竞争力，决策开销仅占推理时间的0.5%。
cards.summaryEn: Diffusion language models require full forward passes at each denoising step due to bidirectional attention, preventing lossless KV caching. EntropyCache uses decoded token maximum entropy as a cheap proxy for cache staleness, triggering recomputation of the k most recently decoded tokens when drift is high, with constant O(V) decision cost. Experiments show 15.2x-26.4x speedup on benchmarks with competitive accuracy and minimal decision overhead.
cards.titleEn: EntropyCache: Decoded Token Entropy Guided KV Caching for Diffusion Language Models
cards.limitations: 仅在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct两个模型上验证，加速效果和准确率可能因模型架构、任务类型和批处理设置而异；熵与缓存漂移的相关性为经验观察，缺乏理论保证；重算最近k个令牌的k值选取未充分讨论。
cards.descriptionEn: EntropyCache is a training-free KV caching method that uses the maximum entropy of newly decoded token distributions as a constant-cost signal to decide when to recompute the cache. It achieves 15.2x-26.4x speedup on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct with competitive accuracy and decision overhead accounting for only 0.5% of inference time.
cards.title: 基于解码令牌熵的扩散语言模型KV缓存加速方法
keyPointsEn: Decoded token entropy correlates with KV cache drift, serving as a cheap proxy for cache staleness.
Feature volatility of decoded tokens persists for multiple steps after unmasking, motivating recomputation of the k most recently decoded tokens.
Per-step decision requires only O(V) computation, independent of context length and model scale.
keyPoints: 解码令牌熵与KV缓存漂移相关，可作为缓存过期的廉价代理。
解码令牌的特征波动在解掩码后持续多步，支持重算最近k个令牌。
每步决策仅需O(V)计算，与上下文长度和模型规模无关。
cards.limitationsEn: Validated only on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct; speedup and accuracy may vary with model architecture, task type, and batch settings. The correlation between entropy and cache drift is empirical without theoretical guarantees. The choice of k for recomputing recent tokens is not fully discussed.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a training-free approximate KV caching strategy for diffusion language models, significantly reducing inference latency with constant decision overhead, facilitating practical deployment.

cards.originalTitle: Geometric Observables for Financial Regime Detection
cards.whyItMatters: 为金融危机状态检测提供了一种与经典方法低相关的无监督几何特征，可能有助于构建更稳健的预警系统，减少误报。
cards.summary: 研究提出四种几何可观测量（Berry相位率、谱熵、约化状态纯度、哈密顿敏感性）作为金融危机状态转换检测器。在2000-2024年17次危机中，Berry相位率的样本外中位Cohen's d为0.72，年误报约1.2次，低于随机森林的3.6次。作者认为几何通道与经典方法相关性低，可能捕捉独立风险信号；但需注意分数构建无监督、超参数选择有监督，结论基于特定数据集。
cards.description: 该研究从股票指数收益的谱嵌入中提取四个几何可观测量，并在17次历史危机中与46种基线方法比较，发现Berry相位率在样本外能有效区分危机状态，且误报率低于监督学习随机森林。
cards.summaryEn: Four geometric observables (Berry Phase Rate, Spectral Entropy, Reduced State Purity, Hamiltonian Sensitivity) are proposed as regime-shift detectors for financial crises. Across 17 crises from 2000 to 2024, Berry Phase Rate achieves an out-of-sample median Cohen's d of 0.72 with about 1.2 false alarms per year, versus 3.6 for a random forest. The authors suggest geometric channels are largely uncorrelated with classical methods and may capture distinct risk signals; however, score construction is unsupervised and hyperparameter selection is supervised, so conclusions are dataset-specific.
cards.titleEn: Geometric Observables Detect Financial Regime Shifts
cards.limitations: 研究基于17次历史危机和九标注窗口，样本量有限；超参数选择使用了有监督步骤；结果依赖于特定的谱嵌入和数据集，泛化到其他市场或资产类别需进一步验证；误报率比较未考虑不同检测器的阈值选择差异。
cards.descriptionEn: The study extracts four geometric observables from a spectral embedding of equity-index returns and compares them against 46 baselines across 17 historical crises, finding that Berry Phase Rate effectively distinguishes crisis regimes out-of-sample with fewer false alarms than a supervised random forest.
cards.title: 几何可观测量可检测金融危机状态转换
keyPointsEn: Berry Phase Rate achieves out-of-sample median Cohen's d = 0.72 (95% bootstrap CI [0.34, 1.18]) and about 1.2 false alarms per year.
Reduced State Purity has the highest in-sample separability (d = 0.83), followed closely by Absorption Ratio (d = 0.80).
Geometric and classical channels have a mean absolute correlation of about 0.22, indicating complementary signals.
keyPoints: Berry相位率在样本外达到中位Cohen's d=0.72（95% bootstrap CI [0.34, 1.18]），年误报约1.2次。

cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on 17 historical crises and nine labeled windows, limiting sample size; hyperparameter selection involves a supervised step; results depend on the specific spectral embedding and dataset, and generalization to other markets or asset classes requires further validation; false alarm comparisons do not account for differences in threshold selection across detectors.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides an unsupervised geometric feature for financial crisis regime detection that is largely uncorrelated with classical methods, potentially enabling more robust early-warning systems with fewer false alarms.

cards.originalTitle: Towards Real-Time Full-Waveform LiDAR Transformers via Intensity-Guided Token Reduction and Physics-Aware Augmentation
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作首次实现实时且精度提升的全波形LiDAR Transformer，解决了FWL感知在实际部署中的计算效率和泛化性瓶颈，对自动驾驶和机器人等实时性要求高的应用具有重要意义。
cards.summary: 全波形LiDAR（FWL）能保留多路径回波和弱信号等丰富反射特性，但现有Transformer方法面临低强度背景区域Token冗余导致的计算成本高和标注数据稀缺导致的泛化性有限两大瓶颈。作者提出FWL-ToPM，利用强度分布选择性减少Token并保留关键波形内容；同时提出FWLAug，一种保持波形结构（每条射线的飞行时间波形和视锥几何）的数据增强框架，作为正则化方法提升对未见场景的泛化。在Ghost-FWL基准上，FWL-ToPM实现超过8倍加速并达到实时吞吐，同时F1分数比先前最先进方法提升近9点；FWLAug在标准基准和分布外测试集上进一步提升性能。这些方法共同推动基于FWL的感知向实际部署迈进。
cards.description: 该研究针对全波形LiDAR Transformer计算成本高和泛化性差的问题，提出强度引导的Token剪枝合并机制FWL-ToPM和波形结构保持的数据增强框架FWLAug，在Ghost-FWL基准上实现超过8倍加速和近9个F1点提升，首次实现实时且精度提升的全波形LiDAR Transformer。
cards.summaryEn: Full-waveform LiDAR (FWL) preserves rich reflection characteristics such as multi-path echoes and weak signals, but existing Transformer-based approaches face two bottlenecks: high computational cost from redundant tokens in low-intensity background regions and limited generalization due to scarce annotated data. The authors propose FWL-ToPM, which leverages intensity distributions to selectively reduce tokens while retaining critical waveform content, and FWLAug, a data augmentation framework designed as a regularization method that preserves waveform structure (the time-of-flight waveform of each ray and frustum geometry) to improve generalization to unseen scenes. On the Ghost-FWL benchmark, FWL-ToPM achieves over 8x speedup at real-time throughput with a nearly 9-point F1 gain over the prior state of the art, and FWLAug further improves performance on both the standard benchmark and an out-of-distribution test set. Together, these methods push FWL-based perception toward practical deployment.
cards.titleEn: Real-Time Full-Waveform LiDAR Transformer via Intensity-Guided Token Reduction and Physics-Aware Augmentation
cards.limitations: 证据边界基于Ghost-FWL基准和作者构建的分布外测试集，未涉及其他数据集或真实部署场景的广泛验证；实时性能提升和F1增益的具体数值依赖于实验设置，泛化性结论需进一步独立复现。
cards.descriptionEn: This study addresses the high computational cost and limited generalization of full-waveform LiDAR Transformers by proposing FWL-ToPM, an intensity-guided token pruning and merging mechanism, and FWLAug, a waveform-structure-preserving data augmentation framework. On the Ghost-FWL benchmark, it achieves over 8x speedup and nearly 9-point F1 gain, establishing the first real-time full-waveform LiDAR Transformer with simultaneous accuracy improvement.
cards.title: 实时全波形LiDAR Transformer：强度引导Token缩减与物理感知增强
keyPointsEn: FWL-ToPM uses intensity distributions for token pruning and merging to reduce redundant tokens in low-intensity background regions while retaining critical waveform content, achieving over 8x speedup and nearly 9-point F1 gain.

FWLAug is a waveform-structure-preserving data augmentation framework that regularizes the model by retaining the time-of-flight waveform of each ray and frustum geometry, improving generalization to unseen scenes.
On the Ghost-FWL benchmark, the method establishes the first real-time full-waveform LiDAR Transformer and validates effectiveness on both the standard benchmark and an out-of-distribution test set.
keyPoints: FWL-ToPM利用强度分布进行Token剪枝与合并，在保留关键波形内容的同时减少低强度背景区域的冗余Token，实现超过8倍加速和近9点F1提升。
FWLAug是一种保持波形结构的数据增强框架，通过保留每条射线的飞行时间波形和视锥几何来正则化模型，提升对未见场景的泛化能力。
在Ghost-FWL基准上，该方法首次实现实时吞吐的全波形LiDAR Transformer，并在标准基准和分布外测试集上均验证了有效性。
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence is based on the Ghost-FWL benchmark and an author-constructed out-of-distribution test set, without extensive validation on other datasets or real deployment scenarios; the specific speedup and F1 gains depend on experimental settings, and generalization conclusions require further independent reproduction.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work establishes the first real-time full-waveform LiDAR Transformer with simultaneous accuracy improvement, addressing the computational efficiency and generalization bottlenecks of FWL perception for practical deployment in latency-sensitive applications such as autonomous driving and robotics.

cards.whyItMatters: 若决策模型能在保持准确性的同时显著降低延迟并输出稳定概率分布，可减少生产环境中对自回归输出解析、重试与后处理的依赖；Drex开放权重与基准结果为此类架构提供了可复现的比较基线。
cards.summary: 事实：Drex包含8B、9B、35B（3B激活）、27B四个开放决策模型，输入为状态（文档、记录或含图像的智能体上下文）与选项类问题，直接输出概率分布；训练结合监督微调、基于调整反馈的强化学习（RLAF）与视觉调优。事实：在Decision Index 0.4.1上Max得67.52，对比Jev 1.14.0的60.70；在Decision Bench v4上与d3-turbo、GPT-6 Sol统计持平，落后Claude Opus 5.5 1.6分；典型请求延迟183毫秒，且选项重排下输出稳定。作者观点：消融显示RLAF提升准确性、一致性损失增强对选项顺序的鲁棒性，决策模型可替代部分自回归推理以降低解析负担与成本。
cards.description: 该工作提出Drex系列决策模型，直接对用户给定选项输出概率分布，无需自回归解码；核心新意在于用RLAF与一致性损失提升准确性与选项顺序鲁棒性，并在公开决策基准上取得领先或持平成绩且延迟显著低于自回归模型，因此对需要低延迟、稳定输出的生产场景具有参考价值。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: Drex includes four open decision models (8B, 9B, 35B with 3B active, and 27B); each request provides a state (document, record, or agent context, optionally with images) and option-based questions, and the model returns a probability distribution directly. Training combines supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from adjusted feedback (RLAF), and vision tuning. Fact: Max scores 67.52 on Decision Index 0.4.1 versus 60.70 for Jev 1.14.0; on Decision Bench v4 it is statistically tied with d3-turbo and GPT-6 Sol and trails Claude Opus 5.5 by 1.6 points; typical latency is 183 ms and outputs are stable under option reordering. Authors' view: ablations show RLAF improves accuracy and consistency losses improve robustness to option order, and decision models can replace some autoregressive reasoning to reduce parsing burden and cost.
cards.titleEn: Drex Decision Models: Non-Autoregressive Choice Architecture with Open Weights
cards.limitations: 证据主要来自作者自报的基准结果与消融，未提供独立复现；Decision Bench v4上仅统计持平或小幅落后，优势并非全面领先；延迟数字对应特定请求与部署条件，未说明硬件与负载；开放模型的实际泛化、长上下文与多模态场景表现仍需外部验证。
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces Drex, a family of decision models that directly output a probability distribution over user-supplied options without autoregressive decoding. Its novelty lies in combining RLAF and consistency losses to improve accuracy and robustness to option order, achieving leading or statistically tied results on public decision benchmarks with markedly lower latency than autoregressive models, making it relevant for production settings requiring low latency and stab
cards.title: Drex决策模型：非自回归选择架构与开放权重
keyPointsEn: Drex includes four open decision models (8B, 9B, 35B with 3B active, and 27B) that directly output option probability distributions without autoregressive decoding.
Training combines supervised fine-tuning, RLAF, and vision tuning; ablations report that RLAF improves accuracy and consistency losses improve robustness to option order.

Max scores 67.52 on Decision Index 0.4.1, leading compared models; on Decision Bench v4 it is statistically tied with d3-turbo and GPT-6 Sol, trails Claude Opus 5.5 by 1.6 points, and answers a typical request in 183 ms.
keyPoints: Drex系列含8B、9B、35B（3B激活）与27B四个开放决策模型，直接输出选项概率分布，无需自回归解码。
训练结合监督微调、RLAF和视觉调优；消融称RLAF提升准确性，一致性损失改善选项顺序鲁棒性。
在Decision Index 0.4.1上Max达67.52领先对比模型；Decision Bench v4上与d3-turbo、GPT-6 Sol统计持平，落后Claude Opus 5.5 1.6分；典型延迟183毫秒。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence mainly comes from author-reported benchmark results and ablations without independent reproduction; on Decision Bench v4 the results are only statistically tied or slightly behind, not a comprehensive lead; latency numbers correspond to specific requests and deployment conditions, with hardware and load unspecified; real-world generalization, long-context, and multimodal performance of the open models still require external validation.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If decision models can maintain accuracy while substantially reducing latency and producing stable probability distributions, they can reduce reliance on parsing, retries, and post-processing of autoregressive outputs in production. Drex's open weights and benchmark results provide a reproducible comparison baseline for this architecture.

cards.originalTitle: You Know What You Will Like: People Predict Their Own Ratings Better Than Recommender Systems
cards.whyItMatters: 该结果量化了直接询问用户所获得的增量信息价值，提示推荐系统可在数据稀疏或物品特定场景下结合用户自报预期，同时为偏好获取的成本与收益权衡、以及推荐评估指标设计提供实证参考。
cards.summary: 研究基于 MovieLens Beliefs 数据集，比较 277 名成员对未看影片的 551 条预期评分与四种机器基准（平台预测、矩阵分解、物品邻域、堆叠模型）的预测准确性。事实是，个体预期与后续实际评分的相关性为 0.69，高于机器基准的 0.34–0.59；将预期加入机器预测后，样本外均方误差降低 26%，且该增益在时间外推和加入历史预期后仍成立。作者据此认为，人群数据丰富时算法已足够，但个体对具体物品拥有额外信息，并据此提出偏好获取与推荐评估的设计原则。
cards.description: 该研究利用 MovieLens Beliefs 数据比较用户自报预期评分与平台推荐算法的预测精度，发现个体对自身评分的预测相关性更高（0.69 vs 0.34–0.59），且加入预期后样本外 MSE 降低 26%。新意在于量化了“直接询问用户”的增量信息价值，并指出其在特定影片上的优势，为推荐系统偏好获取与评估设计提供依据。
cards.summaryEn: Based on the MovieLens Beliefs dataset, the study compares 551 expectation ratings from 277 members about unseen movies with four machine benchmarks: platform prediction, matrix factorization, item neighborhood, and a stacked model. Factually, individuals' expectations correlate 0.69 with later actual ratings, higher than machine benchmarks (0.34–0.59); adding expectations lowers out-of-sample mean squared error by 26%, and the gain holds under temporal validation and when earlier expectations are included. The authors conclude that crowd data suffice where rich, but individuals add item-specific information, and derive design principles for preference elicitation and recommender evaluation.
cards.titleEn: Individuals Predict Their Own Ratings More Accurately Than Recommender Systems: Evidence from MovieLens
cards.limitations: 证据仅基于 MovieLens Beliefs 数据集：26,020 条预期中仅 551 条（来自 277 名成员）在至少一天后获得后续评分，样本代表性和回应率极低（98.8% 的提示未回应）。研究比较的是特定电影集合上的评分预测，不能直接推广到其他领域、其他推荐任务或全部用户群体；机器基准的调参细节和特征集未在摘要中完整披露，增益的稳健性需更多独立数据验证。
cards.descriptionEn: Using MovieLens Beliefs data, this study compares users' self-reported expected ratings with platform and collaborative-filtering predictions. Individuals' expectations correlate more strongly with subsequent ratings (0.69 vs 0.34–0.59), and adding expectations reduces out-of-sample MSE by 26%. The novelty lies in quantifying the incremental value of directly asking users and identifying where person-level information helps, informing preference elicitation and recommender ev
cards.title: 个人评分预测比推荐系统更准：MovieLens 实验证据
keyPointsEn: Individuals' expected ratings correlate 0.69 with subsequent actual ratings, higher than platform prediction (0.34) and trained models (0.54–0.59).
Adding individual expectations as an extra feature reduces out-of-sample mean squared error by 26%, with the gain persisting under temporal validation.

On old, heavily rated movies, machine predictions perform as well as or better than personal expectations; for ordering a user's own movies, trained models are statistically indistinguishable from the person.
keyPoints: 个体对自身评分的预期与后续实际评分的相关性为 0.69，高于平台预测（0.34）和训练模型（0.54–0.59）。
将个体预期作为额外特征加入机器预测，可使样本外均方误差降低 26%，且该增益在时间外推检验中保持。
在用户已评分较多的老电影上，机器预测与个人预期表现相当或更好；但在具体物品排序上，训练模型与个人预测统计上无显著差异。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to the MovieLens Beliefs dataset: of 26,020 expectations, only 551 from 277 members received a subsequent rating at least one day later, indicating very low response rate (98.8% of prompts unanswered) and limited representativeness. The study compares rating prediction on a specific movie set and cannot be directly generalized to other domains, recommendation tasks, or all user groups; tuning details and feature sets of machine benchmarks are not fully disclosed in the abstract, and robustness of the gain requires validation on more independent data.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The results quantify the incremental information value of directly asking users, suggesting recommender systems can incorporate self-reported expectations in data-sparse or item-specific settings, and provide empirical reference for cost-benefit trade-offs in preference elicitation and for recommender evaluation metric design.

cards.originalTitle: NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准把医学AI评测从静态问答推进到照护路径级联合推理，有助于识别模型在证据落地、病情变化解读和咨询判断上的不足。对鼻咽癌这一需要多模态证据与纵向管理的场景，NPCBench 提供了更贴近专科培训流程的测试床，但其结果不构成任何临床或投资建议。
cards.summary: 事实：NPCBench 包含4,777个组件与咨询条目，以及100名患者、417项评分任务的CarePath队列，用于评估模型在鼻咽癌照护路径中的多模态证据整合与纵向状态跟踪能力。事实：在30个受评模型中，21个多模态模型的严格CarePath成功率最高为23%，并观察到“组合差距”——单项任务表现强不代表同一患者的诊断与照护答案联合正确。作者观点：该基准将医学AI评估从静态问答拓展到面向临床工作流的学徒式评估，为肿瘤照护中基于证据且时间连贯的推理提供测试平台。
cards.description: NPCBench 是面向鼻咽癌的临床学徒式基准，将分散的知识问答扩展为贯穿患者照护路径的连贯评估；其新意在于以100名患者的CarePath队列和417项评分任务检验诊断与照护答案是否在路径内同时正确，而非孤立打分。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: NPCBench contains 4,777 component and consultation items plus a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored tasks, designed to assess multimodal evidence integration and longitudinal state tracking in NPC care pathways. Fact: Across 30 evaluated models, strict CarePath success among 21 multimodal models reaches at most 23%, revealing a composition gap whereby strong single-task performance does not ensure jointly correct diagnostic and care answers for the same patient. Author view: the benchmark broadens medical AI evaluation from static QA to apprenticeship-oriented assessment of clinical workflows, offering a testbed for evidence-grounded and temporally coherent reasoning in oncology care.
cards.titleEn: NPCBench: A Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning Benchmark for Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
cards.limitations: 证据边界明确：NPCBench 仅覆盖鼻咽癌单一病种与特定CarePath队列，不能直接外推到其他肿瘤或临床场景；30个受评模型的比较结果反映该基准设定下的表现，严格成功率最高23%不意味着模型在其他任务或数据分布上同样受限；配对对照与医师校准虽用于检验证据落地、纵向修正与咨询评判，但基准本身的评分任务与患者样本规模有限，结论应视为该基准内的观察而非普适临床效能结论。
cards.descriptionEn: NPCBench is a clinical apprenticeship-style benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma that extends isolated knowledge QA to coherent evaluation along a patient care pathway; its novelty lies in testing whether diagnostic and care answers are jointly correct within a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored tasks, rather than scoring steps in isolation.
cards.title: NPCBench：鼻咽癌多模态诊疗路径推理基准
keyPointsEn: NPCBench uses nasopharyngeal carcinoma to extend evaluation from isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, and static vignettes to a continuous task chain spanning guideline knowledge, case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and open-ended consultation.

Its core evaluation unit is joint correctness within a patient-level care pathway: diagnostic and care answers for the same patient must hold together along the pathway, not merely score well step by step.

Among 30 evaluated models, strict CarePath success among 21 multimodal models reaches at most 23%, showing a composition gap between strong single-task performance and pathway-level joint correctness.
keyPoints: NPCBench 以鼻咽癌为场景，将评估从孤立事实题、单图任务和静态案例扩展为指南知识、病例规划、纵向复核、CarePath整合与开放式咨询的连续任务链。
其核心评估单元是患者级照护路径中的联合正确性：同一患者的诊断与照护答案需在路径内同时成立，而非仅看单步得分。
在30个受评模型中，21个多模态模型的严格CarePath成功率最高为23%，显示单项任务强表现与路径级联合正确之间存在组合差距。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries are explicit: NPCBench covers only nasopharyngeal carcinoma and a specific CarePath cohort, so it cannot be directly extrapolated to other cancers or clinical settings; the comparison of 30 evaluated models reflects performance under this benchmark's setup, and a maximum strict success rate of 23% does not imply models are equally limited on other tasks or data distributions; although paired controls and physician calibration are used to examine evidence grounding, longitudinal revision, and consultation judging, the benchmark's scored tasks and patient sample are limited, so conclusions should be treated as observations within this benchmark rather than universal clinical efficacy claims.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark moves medical AI evaluation from static QA toward joint reasoning at the care-pathway level, helping identify gaps in evidence grounding, interpretation of patient state changes, and consultation judgment. For NPC, which requires multimodal evidence and longitudinal management, NPCBench offers a testbed closer to specialty training workflows, though its results do not constitute clinical or investment advice.

cards.originalTitle: What you missed at Hugging Face Open Together
cards.whyItMatters: 对关注 AI 与量化交叉领域的研究者而言，该条目可作为追踪 Hugging Face 社区活动信息的入口；但在缺少内容摘要的情况下，不能据此形成技术判断或研究结论。
cards.summary: 输入仅表明 Hugging Face 发布了题为“What you missed at Hugging Face Open Together”的短视频，未提供活动内容摘要。因此无法判断其中是否包含模型、工具或方法层面的新信息。以下要点仅基于标题与来源形式，不涉及对活动实质内容的判断。
cards.description: 该内容来自 Hugging Face 发布的短视频，指向其 Open Together 活动；但输入仅有标题与链接，没有活动摘要、讲者观点或技术细节，因此无法确认任何新发现或具体发布。其潜在用途是作为线索，引导读者回到原始视频核实活动内容。
cards.summaryEn: The input only shows that Hugging Face published a short video titled "What you missed at Hugging Face Open Together," without a content summary. It is therefore impossible to determine whether it contains new model, tool, or method information. The points below are based solely on the title and source format, not on the substance of the event.
cards.titleEn: Overview of Hugging Face Open Together Content
cards.limitations: 输入仅含标题、来源、作者、发布时间和链接，且 source_summary 为空。视频实际内容未知，无法验证活动是否涉及量化金融、模型发布或方法创新。本文不补造任何数字、实验或结论，所有判断均以标题信息为限。
cards.descriptionEn: This item is a short video from Hugging Face pointing to its Open Together event. The input contains only a title and a link, with no event summary, speaker viewpoints, or technical details, so no new findings or releases can be confirmed. Its limited use is as a pointer back to the original video for verification.
cards.title: Hugging Face 开放协作活动内容概览
